rules.statement: In the case of concealed fraud, an action is available from the time of the discovery of the fraud, or from the time the party defrauded might by due diligence have come to know of it.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is a well-known principle of English equity that in the case of concealed fraud of this description, an action is available from the time of the discovery of the fraud, or from the time the party defrauded might by due diligence have come to know of it."
